title: cmd
description: Topic {prefix}/{robot_id}/cmd, HA to ROS, QoS 1, never retained, message expiry ceil(max_age_ms / 1000) s. Either a task command or a cancel command, told apart by type. id is a UUID4 generated by HA and names the reply topics; robot_id must equal the topic segment. sig is present only when a shared secret is configured. Size limit 16 KiB.

issued_at.description: HA clock when the command was built. The node accepts when -skew <= now - issued_at <= min(max_age_ms, command.max_age_cap_ms) + skew.

max_age_ms.description: How long after issued_at the command may still be accepted. Capped on the node by command.max_age_cap_ms (default 30000).

task_command.description: Start a task from the announced catalogue.

params.description: Parameters for the task; an empty object when the task takes none. The node validates them against the announced params_subset schema.

timeout_s.description: null means the announced timeout_s; a value is clamped to command.task_timeout_cap_s on the node.

cancel_command.description: Cancel a running task. accepted is the terminal outcome of the cancel's own id; the cancelled task's result follows under its own id.

target_id.description: Id of the task to cancel, or null for the active motion task.
